scripts.dev: npm run build -w @video/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,worker,web -c yellow,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @video/shared" "npm run dev -w @video/api" "npm run dev -w @video/worker" "npm run dev -w @video/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @video/shared && npm run build -w @video/api && npm run build -w @video/worker && npm run build -w @video/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run start -w @video/api" "npm run start -w @video/worker" "npm run start -w @video/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @video/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
